[USER] User found it interesting how trade agreements impact global economics and politics and inquired about other major trade agreements in the works.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided examples of other major trade agreements currently in the works:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership (RCEP): Proposed trade agreement between 16 Asia-Pacific countries, including China, Japan, and India, covering about a third of global GDP.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership (CPTPP): Signed in 2018 by 11 countries, including Canada, Japan, and Australia, originally known as the Trans-Pacific Partnership (TPP).  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA): Agreement between 54 African countries signed in March 2018, aiming to create a single market for goods and services in Africa.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The global economy is becoming increasingly interconnected, and trade agreements are important for facilitating that integration.
